answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow unlock stops fakes. A new identity stakes 40 POA and records its pattern. An identity free to wander with no steady pattern never unlocks higher tiers. Each epoch matching its pattern lights another lantern and climbs one rung of the trellis. Deviation freezes the unlock; a confirmed fake forfeits its 40 POA bond. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 40 = 4,000 POA, while an honest agent pays 40 POA once.
